answer: Rule: every identity must answer a liveness challenge inside the same 30-minute window each epoch. Each challenge is a verifiable delay function taking 15 minutes of dedicated compute, so one machine keeps at most 2 identities alive. A fake locks a 50-unit deposit, burned on a missed heartbeat. 100 fakes need 50 machines plus 5,000 locked units; the ocean of cheap clones dries up before they can forge a quorum, and the sable audit trail records every miss.
